name: Class of the Living Dead
source:
High school couldn’t be more boring for you. Sure, you’ve got a cute friend who you’ve known since childhood, but your only true joy is playing video games. That all changes one day though when the whole town is overtaken by zombies!

You manage to find safety in a classroom along with a couple of other students including the beautiful student council president and the edgy outcast of your class. But the barricades will only last so long and the number of zombies is only increasing! Will you be able to escape to safety along with your three new allies? Find out in Class of the Living Dead!
translation:
高中对你来说再无聊不过了。当然，你有一个从小就认识的可爱朋友，但你唯一真正的乐趣就是玩电子游戏。然而有一天，当整个城镇都被僵尸占领时，一切都改变了！

你设法和其他几个学生一起在教室里找到安全感，其中包括美丽的学生会主席和班上急躁的弃儿。但路障只能持续这么长时间，而僵尸的数量只会增加！你能和你的三位新盟友一起逃到安全的地方吗？快来《活死人课堂》中寻找答案吧！
